title: Better Craftable Cobwebs
description: Makes cobwebs craftable, really good for PVP or Anarchy servers!
body:
**About the pack**

This pack makes it so you can craft 2 cobwebs with 5 string so getting cobwebs is easier on PVP or anarchy servers.
